ATOMIC LOGOS — 2 NOVEMBER 2026

Primary: atomic-lowercase-color, lowercase atomic for light backgrounds.
Use atomic-lowercase-dark on dark backgrounds (coloured symbol and light lettering).
Uppercase alternatives and the standalone symbol are also supplied.
SVG files preserve the exact original artwork. PNG exports are transparent at 512 and 2048 pixels wide.
PDF exports preserve appearance; gradient shadow filters may be rasterized. Use SVG as the master.
originals/ contains all 12 supplied files, including comparison and application mockups.
Mockups illustrate logo use; they are not product screenshots.

TYPOGRAPHY: The supplied wordmark is Inter SemiBold (600), verified against Inter 3.19. Keep its current weight.

MONOCHROME: Use atomic-lowercase-black/white for complete lockups and atomic-symbol-black/white for symbols. Four separate shapes and transparent gaps preserve the overlap. Do not use a flattened silhouette or brightness/invert filter. The dark-background colour logo is distinct from the monochrome white logo. See monochrome/README.txt.
